newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian gold ends down, silver unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Indian gold ends down, silver unchanged.

text.p: Gold prices fell marginally on Thursday on sluggish demand and light profit-taking, dealers said.
Gold was up 20 rupees per 10 gramme on Wednesday. Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) fell 100 rupees to 58,700.
"Arrivals however remained low and trade was range-bound," said a bullion trader.
Silver ended unchanged after opening higher as industrial buying petered out during the day, traders said.
Silver was up by 50 rupees per kg on Wednesday.
Market sentiment was subdued at close of trade on limited enquiries traders said. They said they expected the market to remain weak on Friday.
